component.name: Pensum
component.summary: Plan your day and track the time you spend on tasks

description.p: Pensum is a light task list with time tracking for Phosh phones and the desktop. It keeps your tasks in the backup format of Super Productivity, so a backup moves between both apps without changes.

ul.li: Tasks with subtasks, notes, estimates and a planned day
A timer per task that books the time on the day you worked
Import and export of Super Productivity backups, and automatic backups
Works offline; needs no account and no network

description.p: Pensum is an independent project and not affiliated with the Super Productivity project.
First version: Today, projects and tags, tasks with subtasks and a timer, in Super Productivity's backup format.
